eastland-feed-grain.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 19 Eastland Feed & Grain locations across Illinois, Iowa and Wisconsin. Illinois has 11 of them in towns like Mendota, Peru and Mount Carroll, while Iowa has 4 including Clinton and Dyersville and Wisconsin has 4 including Monroe and Shullsburg. The table carries bids for corn, soybeans and wheat.

elkhorn-valley-grain.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 3 Elkhorn Valley Grain locations, all in Nebraska. The towns are Dunbar, Hadar and Wahoo. The table carries corn and soybeans, and that is the whole list.
